name: Catch
author: Taha Sadough
description: Native download manager for Omarchy: bar status, Rust backend, browser handoff.

barWidget.description: Download queue status and controls. Click opens Catch; right-click opens the download folder.

schema.label: Catch command (name on PATH or absolute path)
Parallel downloads
schema.description: How many files download at once; the rest wait queued.

schema.label: Connections per file
schema.description: Byte-range connections used for large files; 1 disables segmented downloads. Total connections are shared across transfers.

schema.label: Bandwidth mode
schema.description: Connection default: unlimited uses what the parallel and segment settings add up to, balanced halves it, low quarters it. An explicit limit below always wins.

schema.label: Bandwidth limit (KB/s, 0 = none)
schema.description: Global download rate cap, shared by every running transfer.

schema.label: Schedule
schema.description: Off means anytime; on parks transfers outside the window.

schema.label: Panel position
schema.description: Where the panel opens: under the bar icon, top centre, centre of screen, left or right pane, or bottom centre.
